newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dollar ends firmer in lackluster trading.
newsitem.headline: Canada dollar ends firmer in lackluster trading.

text.p: * Canada's dollar closed firmer at C$1.3442 (US$0.7440) on Monday from Friday's close of C$1.3485 (US$0.7416) in fairly thin trading, dealers said.
* They said interest from offshore buyers overnight and corporate buyers during the day was not enough to push the currency past the key C$1.3435 (US$0.7443) level.
But the interest to buy Canadian dollars was not strong enough to push the currency through C$1.3435, a key technical level, dealers said.
"Today there hasn't been enough movement to trigger a lot of interest," Wateridge said.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar rose to 1.2252 marks from Friday's close of 1.2071 marks and edged up to 88.91 yen from 88.09 yen.
